import json, subprocess, sys
MAIN = '/workspace/submission/main.py'

def run(doc, raw=None):
    data = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(doc).encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', MAIN], input=data, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
    assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, p.stderr[-2000:])
    out = p.stdout.decode()
    assert out.endswith('\n'), repr(out[-20:])
    return json.loads(out), p

def ok(doc):
    res, p = run(doc)
    assert 'error' not in res, res
    return res

def bad(doc=None, raw=None):
    res, p = run(doc, raw)
    assert res == {"error": "invalid-input"}, res
    return res
